Definition: a Madian or native of Madai
BiblicalUsage: Maday is a Mede, a native of Madai, and it appears once, in Daniel 11:1, where the speaker stood to confirm and strengthen Darius the Mede in his first year.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a one-word demonym like this one anchors Daniel's visions in real kings and real years.
